ruleDefinitions.name: Boot Configuration Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the bcdedit command to tamper with the boot configuration data. This technique is often times used by malware or attackers as a destructive way before launching ransomware.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bcdedit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bcdedit\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*set.*") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*bootstatuspolicy.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ignoreallfailures.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*recoveryenabled.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*no.*"))))
